# Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics — facts

## Definitions

- [statement] scoreDetails is a boolean option on $search (default false); the breakdown is read with {$meta: "searchScoreDetails"} in a following $project stage. The returned object has value (top-level equals searchScore), description, and a recursive details array. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-search/score/get-details/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Score Details BM25 Diagnostics · also: https://dev.to/franckpachot/atlas-search-score-details-the-bm25-calculation-2g55

## Structure and components

- [statement] $rankFusion ranked pipelines must begin with $search/$vectorSearch/$geoNear or contain an explicit $sort; input pipelines must emit unmodified documents, so any modification (e.g. $project) must come after the fusion stage. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/rankfusion/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Hybrid Search $rankFusion $scoreFusion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview/
- [statement] The details tree is deeply nested (overall score, per-field scores, per-term, idf/tf components); in mongosh, config.set('inspectDepth', Infinity) is needed to print it fully. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-search/score/get-details/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Score Details BM25 Diagnostics · also: https://dev.to/franckpachot/atlas-search-score-details-the-bm25-calculation-2g55
- [statement] Theory background only: Robertson and Zaragoza derive BM25 using a probabilistic relevance framework with term-frequency saturation and document-length normalization. Use these components to interpret a diagnostic explanation; this paper does not establish Atlas syntax, Lucene defaults or search-node behavior. (low confidence) — https://www.ccs.neu.edu/home/vip/teach/IRcourse/IR_surveys/robertson_foundations.pdf · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Score Details BM25 Diagnostics

## How it works

- [statement] BM25 scores can vary between identical queries when routed to different search nodes (per-node corpus statistics for N, n, avgdl). MongoDB suggests stableTfl or boolean scoring when deterministic ordering matters, such as for pagination. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-01) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-search/score/get-details/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Score Details BM25 Diagnostics

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Lucene 8.0 removed the constant (k1+1) factor from the BM25 numerator (LUCENE-8563). Ranking is unchanged but absolute scores are lower, roughly 2.2x lower than implementations that keep the factor. Raw Atlas scores are therefore not comparable to older Elasticsearch/Solr/Tantivy numbers; only compare rank order. The old behaviour lives on in LegacyBM25Similarity. (high confidence) — https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/LUCENE-8563 · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Score Details BM25 Diagnostics · also: https://dev.to/franckpachot/atlas-search-score-details-the-bm25-calculation-2g55

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Each $scoreFusion input pipeline must be both a selection pipeline and a scoring pipeline: it must begin with $search/$vectorSearch/$match (text search) or include an explicit $score stage; allowed stages are $match, $geoNear, $search, $vectorSearch, $sort, $skip, $limit. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/scorefusion/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Hybrid Search $rankFusion $scoreFusion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview/

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] MongoDB recommends weighting lexical vs vector per query rather than static weights; limit results per sub-pipeline, and raise per-pipeline result counts when sub-pipelines return mostly disjoint results. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Hybrid Search $rankFusion $scoreFusion
- [statement] $scoreFusion minimum version is MongoDB 8.3 per the current reference and overview docs, while the MongoDB product blog says 8.2+; $rankFusion is 8.0+ in the reference. Follow the current operator reference for deployment eligibility rather than the older blog. The overview warns that upgrading from 8.0 may require pausing $rankFusion queries; confirm the upgrade procedure for the selected target release. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-01) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/scorefusion/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Hybrid Search $rankFusion $scoreFusion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/product-release-announcements/boost-search-relevance-mongodb-atlas-native-hybrid-search, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview/
- [statement] OpenSearch-only benchmarks (BEIR, six datasets) found RRF averaged 3.86% lower NDCG@10 than score-based hybrid (0.69% worse on ArguAna to 8.13% worse on FIQA) with small latency gains; RRF buys robustness to score-distribution shifts and outliers, at the cost of discarding score magnitude. These results do not establish an Atlas tradeoff; evaluate Atlas on its own relevance judgments and workloads. (low confidence) (verified as of 2025-11-11) — https://opensearch.org/blog/introducing-reciprocal-rank-fusion-hybrid-search/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Hybrid Search $rankFusion $scoreFusion
- [statement] Enabling scoreDetails may degrade query performance, so use it for diagnosis rather than leaving it on in production queries. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-search/score/get-details/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Score Details BM25 Diagnostics

## Facts and statements

- [statement] $rankFusion (MongoDB 8.0+) implements Reciprocal Rank Fusion: score = sum over pipelines of w/(60 + rank), where 60 is a fixed, non-configurable constant and w is the per-pipeline weight (default 1, non-negative). (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/rankfusion/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Hybrid Search $rankFusion $scoreFusion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview/
- [statement] $scoreFusion normalizes each pipeline's scores with one of none, sigmoid (per-score, distribution-independent), or minMaxScaler (uses observed min/max of the result set), then combines via method avg (default) or a custom expression; weights default to 1 and are mutually exclusive with combination.expression. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/scorefusion/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Hybrid Search $rankFusion $scoreFusion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview/
- [statement] Both stages work on a single collection only, de-duplicate so each document appears at most once, require unique pipeline names (no '.', no leading '$', non-empty, no null char), and sub-pipelines run serially, not in parallel. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/rankfusion/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Hybrid Search $rankFusion $scoreFusion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/scorefusion/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview/
- [statement] scoreDetails:true populates $scoreDetails metadata but does not output it; project it explicitly via $meta/$project/$addFields. MongoDB does not guarantee the scoreDetails format, so do not parse it in production code. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/rankfusion/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Hybrid Search $rankFusion $scoreFusion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/scorefusion/
- [statement] Fusion sub-pipelines do not support document modifications such as $project or storedSource fields, or cross-collection search. For $rankFusion specifically, the overview permits views on MongoDB 8.0+ but excludes use within view definitions and on time series collections. Do not extrapolate that version floor to $scoreFusion. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/vector-search/hybrid-search/hybrid-search-overview/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Hybrid Search $rankFusion $scoreFusion · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/rankfusion/
- [statement] Algorithm background only: Cormack, Clarke and Büttcher define reciprocal rank fusion as summing reciprocal rank terms, and use k=60 in their experiments. This paper establishes the rank-fusion method; it does not establish MongoDB stage eligibility, supported pipelines or Atlas performance. (low confidence) — https://cormack.uwaterloo.ca/cormacksigir09-rrf.pdf · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Hybrid Search $rankFusion $scoreFusion
- [statement] Default BM25 score = boost x idf x tf, with idf = log(1 + (N - n + 0.5) / (n + 0.5)) and tf = freq / (freq + k1 * (1 - b + b * dl / avgdl)); Lucene defaults k1 = 1.2 and b = 0.75. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-search/score/get-details/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Score Details BM25 Diagnostics · also: https://dev.to/franckpachot/atlas-search-score-details-the-bm25-calculation-2g55
- [statement] Non-BM25 scorers produce different detail trees: boolean counts 1 per matched term, stableTfl uses boost x tr x tf with term length as a rarity proxy, and the near operator uses pivot / (pivot + distance). (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/atlas-search/score/get-details/ · keywords: Atlas Hybrid Fusion and BM25 Diagnostics, Score Details BM25 Diagnostics
